purpose: Intentional authored rear-wing, folding hinge and adjacent pocket revision. This is not a claim that all geometry remains unchanged. Preserve the accepted tablet artwork and every unrelated vehicle part.

provenance.baselineMeaning: Accepted tablet-artwork publication before the rear-wing seating correction.
provenance.historicalTabletGuard: The original six tablet-artwork regression tests were run unchanged against the accepted pre-wing publication and all six passed. Their anchors below are retained, not replaced with new geometry goldens.
provenance.authoringSafetyRevision: 2026-10-21: preflight, atomic source save, and both image path padding normalization. Existing source changed only in unused Image.name string padding; geometry, textures, and GLB untouched. No regeneration claimed.

methods.runtime: SHA256 of exact raw typed-array attribute and index bytes, all exact floating-point per-triangle attributes with cyclic-start/triangle-order normalization but winding preserved, and exact world transforms. No rounding. Full GLB non-storage structure and every node are also hashed with sorted JSON keys.
methods.source: Read-only Blender 4.3.2 snapshots. Each editable mesh records canonical polygon coordinates/material/smoothing, position-associated corner normals and UVs, world matrix, parent, materials and element counts at 1e-6 precision. This is a stated source-comparison tolerance, not byte identity; exact current .blend SHA256 also binds the audited source. Hood loop ordering changed but its geometry and position-associated normal multiset did not.
methods.textures: All eight source PNG files and embedded/packed images are exact baseline bytes, including the restored UI PNG. No rerender or tablet artwork update. The historical tablet tests independently decode RGBA and retain full UI pixel/compositing/live-readout checks.
methods.portability: All runtime checks use only this checkout and retained fingerprints; the read-only Blender source verifier likewise needs no sibling backup. Every authored Blender image is packed with a //textures/ relative path.

checks.additionalFitTests: tests/roadster-wing-seating.test.mjs independently checks the actual stowed exported triangles against the rear quarter and the authored slanted hinge. Preservation alone is not a fit test.
